_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV: MWh volumes (KPI vital utility) > Customers (base) > Capex (growth signal) > Revenue > EPS (cyclical bottom).

kpis.signal: Volumes régulés (VA, NC, SC, UT). Stable ~98-100 TWh. Croissance data centers VA 2024.
kpis.description_fr: Volume électricité vendus aux clients régulés (Dominion Virginia, NC, SC, UT). Boost data centers VA.
kpis.description_en: Electric volumes sold to regulated customers (VA, NC, SC, UT). Virginia data center boost.

kpis.signal: Croissance clientèle steady. Virginie en forte expansion démographique (relocation tech).

kpis.description_en: Regulated customers (residential + commercial + industrial). Strong VA growth (data centers, relocations).

kpis.signal: Capex en pleine hausse. Driver rate base + future earnings. CVOW offshore wind + transmission VA.

kpis.description_en: Regulated asset investments. Targets +6-8%/year rate base. Includes CVOW offshore wind ($10.7B).

kpis.signal: CA stable. 2022 inflé par energy trading sortie. Cycle normal 14-15 Mds $.

kpis.description_en: Consolidated revenue. Regulated Electric 80% + Gas Distribution (partial divestment). Stable since 2023.

kpis.signal: BPA en bas de cycle. Cible 5-7% CAGR long terme. CVOW + rate cases vont relancer.

kpis.description_en: Operating EPS non-GAAP. Drives Dominion guidance. 5-7% CAGR target via rate base + CVOW.

_notes: Dominion Energy. Regulated utility (VA, NC, SC, UT). Major CVOW offshore wind project ongoing.
